name: paper-to-quiz
description: Convert PDF exams and worksheets into secure, image-based WordPress quizzes.

scripts.check:build-portability: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const path=require('node:path');const root=process.cwd().replaceAll('\\','/');const files=fs.readdirSync('build').filter((name)=>/\.(?:js|css|php)$/.test(name));const leaked=files.filter((name)=>fs.readFileSync(path.join('build',name),'utf8').replaceAll('\\','/').includes(root));if(leaked.length){console.error('Build contains the local workspace path:',leaked);process.exit(1);}"
scripts.test:php: wp-env run cli composer --working-dir=wp-content/plugins/paper-to-quiz install --quiet && wp-env run cli composer --working-dir=wp-content/plugins/paper-to-quiz test
scripts.i18n: wp-env run cli sh -c "cd wp-content/plugins/paper-to-quiz && php -d memory_limit=512M /usr/local/bin/wp i18n make-pot . languages/paper-to-quiz.pot --exclude=node_modules,tests,languages,build/pdf.worker.min.js --allow-root" && wp-env run cli sh -c "cd wp-content/plugins/paper-to-quiz && /usr/local/bin/wp i18n update-po languages/paper-to-quiz.pot languages/paper-to-quiz-tr_TR.po --allow-root" && wp-env run cli sh -c "cd wp-content/plugins/paper-to-quiz && /usr/local/bin/wp i18n make-mo languages/paper-to-quiz-tr_TR.po languages --allow-root" && wp-env run cli sh -c "cd wp-content/plugins/paper-to-quiz && /usr/local/bin/wp i18n make-json languages --no-purge --use-map=languages/paper-to-quiz-json-map.json --allow-root"
scripts.env:install: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const path = require('node:path'); const wpEnv = process.platform === 'win32' ? path.resolve('node_modules/.bin/wp-env.cmd') : 'wp-env'; const options = process.platform === 'win32' ? { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true } : { stdio: 'inherit' }; const run = (args) => { const result = spawnSync(wpEnv, args, options); if (result.status !== 0) process.exit(result.status || 1); }; const installed = spawnSync(wpEnv, ['run', 'cli', 'wp', 'core', 'is-installed'], options); if (installed.status !== 0) run(['run', 'cli', 'wp', 'core', 'install', '--url=http://localhost:8888', '--title=Paper to Quiz Integration', '--admin_user=admin', '--admin_password=paper-to-quiz-integration', '--admin_email=admin@example.com', '--skip-email']); run(['run', 'cli', 'wp', 'plugin', 'activate', 'paper-to-quiz']);"
scripts.test:integration:run: wp-env run cli env WP_ENVIRONMENT_TYPE=local PTQ_ALLOW_REGRESSION=1 wp eval-file wp-content/plugins/paper-to-quiz/tests/data-regression.php && wp-env run cli env WP_ENVIRONMENT_TYPE=local PTQ_ALLOW_REGRESSION=1 wp eval-file wp-content/plugins/paper-to-quiz/tests/rest-regression.php
scripts.test:integration: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const npm = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'npm.cmd' : 'npm'; const npmOptions = { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }; const run = (script) => { const result = spawnSync(npm, ['run', script], npmOptions); if (result.status !== 0) { const error = new Error('npm run ' + script + ' failed'); error.exitCode = result.status || 1; throw error; } }; let exitCode = 1; try { run('env:start'); run('env:install'); run('test:integration:run'); exitCode = 0; } catch (error) { console.error(error.message); exitCode = error.exitCode || 1; } finally { const stop = spawnSync(npm, ['run', 'env:stop'], npmOptions); if (exitCode === 0 && stop.status !== 0) { exitCode = stop.status || 1; } } process.exit(exitCode);"
